research_rationale: Page 1 establishes an emergency declaration and eight-hour-law exception confined to paving between 17th, 23rd, B and Virginia Avenue NW, plus a separate mandatory time-and-half overtime compensation proviso. No express sunset is stated. The August 31, 1918 appropriation recital and wartime description do not establish actual completion or first cessation. No held completion, cancellation or first extinguishing source establishes the end of either command. Accrued compensation is distinct from prospective work relief; neither occurrence of overtime nor payment/extinction is proved. Whole-case proposal withheld.
savings_reason: No express savings clause in page 1. Potential earned compensation survives analytically apart from prospective relief; no evidence proves actual claims arose, were paid, or extinguished.

research_rationale: Page 1 adds Military Intelligence Division, General Staff as principal US Army representative on the Board created by EO 3206. This is a continuing composition amendment, not a signing-exhausted permission. EO 3391 page 1 adds Federal Power Commission, Army Air Service and Naval Aviation without removing Military Intelligence. Held EO 4547 text adds further agencies without expressly removing it. Held EO 7262 transcription restates the parent and expressly includes Military Intelligence as item 15, but drops the principal-representative wording: this requires exact parent/intermediate comparison and is not automatically an ending under the strike-and-insert ruling. Held EO 9094 text section 1 abolishes the Board and sections 2-3 transfer/direct functions, a specific relevant cessation candidate dated March 10, 1942. However its raw original and the complete earlier chain are not available for a supported first-end determination. Frozen EO 3246 OCR inserts intrusive text between representative-of-the and US Army and includes annotations; no bytes repaired. Whole-case proposal withheld.
savings_reason: No express savings clause in EO 3246 page. EO 9094 extracted sections 2-3 preserve functional performance under Budget Director while abolishing Board; do not equate function transfer with surviving Board seat or infer extinction of prior acts.

independent_command_check: No separate reporting, compensation, deadline or implementation command appears on EO 3246 page. Parent organization and subsequent transferred functions must not be conflated with this membership rule.
